cutout.indexing_note: JHTDB getCutout coordinates are recorded in 1-based inclusive form; zero-based inclusive equivalents are also recorded.

space.selection_basis: Half-domain translation of the Pilot-A origin in x, y, and z. This leaves a 256-grid-point unselected band between the Pilot-A and Pilot-B cubes along each periodic axis and gives exactly zero shared spatial grid points.

time.selection_basis: Ten consecutive stored coarse frames beginning at physical time t=1.000. This preserves Pilot A's 10-frame duration and dt while giving zero frame/time overlap and a 0.982 physical-time gap from the end of Pilot A.

independence.independence_statement: Pilot B uses a disjoint 256^3 cube and a disjoint 10-frame time window from the same JHTDB forced-isotropic coarse dataset. No Pilot-A spatial grid point or stored frame is reused.
independence.stopping_rule_statement: This is the single preregistered Pilot-B physical sample. It must not be replaced under the Pilot-B label after its outcome is seen.

selection_lock.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':')
selection_lock.meaning: Acquisition code must verify this hash before any JHTDB query. Coordinates and time indices are therefore frozen before Pilot-B data are inspected.

public_provenance.note: Pilot B is to be acquired directly from JHTDB; the Hugging Face repository contains the Pilot-A 256^3 subset only.

acquisition.method: givernylocal getCutout, serial registered-token queries, z slabs, assembled into one HDF5 file
acquisition.note: Acquisition metadata are populated only after the physical source has been downloaded and validated. Null values here are not placeholders for results; they explicitly mean acquisition has not yet occurred.

readiness.condition: Satisfied: source exists, selection lock verified, HDF5 validation passed, SHA-256 recorded.

provenance_note: This source-selection record is created after the Pilot-B analysis protocol freeze but before Pilot-B data acquisition or analysis. It does not alter any frozen analysis setting or criterion.
